panel.title: Lark Bot
panel.subtitle: Talk to this workspace from Lark
status.title: Connection
status.enabledHint: When off, no messages are received and the connection closes.
credentials.title: App credentials
credentials.hint: From the Lark developer console. Stored locally; the secret is never echoed.
credentials.appSecretPlaceholder: Already set; leave blank to keep
credentials.clearHint: This removes the credentials for {appId} (App ID and App Secret).
credentials.clearWarning: The long connection closes immediately; reconnecting requires entering them again.
credentials.appSecretRequired: App Secret is required for the first setup
register.scanHint: No app yet? Scan with Lark to create and authorize one; credentials are saved automatically.
register.waitingHint: Scan the QR code with Lark and confirm on your phone. Credentials are saved automatically.
register.qrHint: This QR code is for this authorization only. Do not forward it.
register.expires: The QR code is valid for about {minutes} minutes and works for one user only.
register.done: App created; App ID ends with {appId}
register.failed: Failed to create the app. Please retry.
behavior.title: Message behavior
behavior.typingHint: Adds a Get (received) reaction on arrival, then appends DONE to the original message only once the reply is actually delivered (queueing does not count); both stay on the message. Lark has no official typing API.
direct.title: Session settings
direct.hint: Without the super agent, Lark messages go to a session this plugin owns.
direct.coreNotice: These are standalone-mode settings. Once you switch to the super agent they stop applying, and the super agent takes over.
direct.summaryCore: Switched to the super agent; these settings no longer apply
direct.steerHint: Regular messages and /send join a running turn; turn this off to queue until the turn ends. /queue always queues and ignores this switch.
direct.workspaceHint: Where new sessions are created; send /new to apply.
direct.workspaceMissing: The selected workspace no longer exists
direct.workspaceUnavailable: The host provides no workspace service
reminder.title: Question and approval reminders
reminder.hint: In standalone mode, send a Lark reminder when a question or tool approval waits for you.
reminder.enabledHint: When off, questions and approvals wait in the Web UI only.
reminder.delayInvalid: Enter an integer from 0 to 120 minutes.
error.connection: Cannot reach the host. Refresh the page and retry.
error.contract: Panel and plugin versions differ. Restart dsh web.
longTask.title: Long-running tasks
longTask.hint: Notify you in Lark when a turn runs long or fails. Standalone sessions only.
longTask.enabledHint: Send duration and conclusion after a turn that ran past the threshold.
longTask.thresholdInvalid: The threshold must be a whole number of minutes between 1 and 1440.
longTask.failureHint: Notify immediately when a turn fails or is aborted externally, regardless of duration. A stop you pressed yourself does not count.

meta.title: Lark Bot
meta.description: IM bridge that connects Lark to DeepSeek Harness
